en: So finally, let's get started with our first
key pain point, our first area of
improvement, and that would be names.
In this module, we are going to focus on
naming things, so on assigning good names.
We'll focus on all the nameable things in
development, which would be variables,
constants, and properties.
Functions and methods,
and of course also classes.
We are going to explore why names matter
exactly and how good names can help us.
We'll then most importantly dive into rules
and concepts for assigning good names and
we'll compare these names to bad names to
really see the difference.
And of course, as promised, we'll have
plenty of small examples and demos and also
a challenge for you at the end of this
module apply what you learned.
